record.field: {{ (object.company_id or user.company_id).name }}: SEPA direct debit mandate

div.p: From now on we would like to collect our invoices by SEPA direct debit. Please authorize this through the link below. You confirm your bank account with a symbolic payment of EUR 0.01 through your bank; this amount is not invoiced.

a.style: background-color: #875A7B; padding: 8px 16px; color: #fff; border-radius: 5px; text-decoration: none;

div.p: You can withdraw the mandate at any time through your bank or by contacting us.
